openings: Thank you for instructing {{first}} to act for {{second}} in connection with its proposed refinancing.
This letter confirms the terms of our engagement: the scope of the work we will do for you, who will do it, and how our fees will be charged.
We are pleased to confirm that {{first}} will audit the financial statements of {{second}} for the year ending 31 March 2027.
This letter sets out the basis on which we will carry out that engagement and the respective responsibilities of {{secondShort}} and of us.

sections.heading: Scope
variants: Our work covers reviewing and negotiating the facility agreement and security documents, and advising on conditions precedent. It does not include tax or regulatory advice.
We will carry out the work in accordance with applicable auditing standards and report to the members of the company.

sections.heading: Fees
variants: We estimate our fees at GBP 45,000 to GBP 55,000 plus VAT and disbursements, and will tell you promptly if we expect to exceed that estimate.
Our fees are charged at hourly rates between GBP 180 and GBP 520 and are billed monthly.

sections.heading: Terms of Business
variants: Our standard terms of business are enclosed and apply to this engagement. Either of us may end the engagement by written notice.
Our liability to you for this engagement is limited to GBP 5 million. Please sign and return a copy of this letter to confirm your agreement.
